title: The Tiny Wobble That Revealed a World
short_teaser: Many planets beyond our solar system were detected because their gravity caused a star to wobble slightly.
story: Many planets beyond our solar system were detected because their gravity caused a star to wobble slightly. Astronomers learned to measure a subtle movement that could not be seen directly. Small repeated signals can point to something much larger. Discovery grows when we notice what does not fit, stay with the question, and resist explaining it away too quickly. The lasting value is not merely knowing the fact. It is seeing the pattern beneath it and considering where that same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
impact: Small repeated signals can point to something much larger. Discovery grows when we notice what does not fit, stay with the question, and resist explaining it away too quickly.
spark_application: Write down one unexpected result or unanswered question from your own work. List three possible explanations before choosing one. Save a short note about what you noticed, what surprised you, or what you may want to revisit.
